verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking controls are a fair privacy question for any app, including a local iOS terminal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, tracking, or any setting to opt out of them. Being open source under a FreeBSD license is not a documented opt-out control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
